originalTitle: James 1:17 (Jesus Is King) - Kid Rock [Official Music Video}
content: Kid Rock’s new video, “James 1:17 (Jesus Is King),” is the first single from his upcoming album Halfway 2 Jesus. James 1:17 is a Bible verse from the New Testament book of James that teaches every good thing comes from God. The video is dedicated to Jimmie Bones and Kalvin Lynch. Jimmie is the keyboard player of The Twisted Brown Trucker Band since inception, currently battling ALS. Kalvin has an inoperable brain tumor and his Make a Wish was to play drums with Kid Rock. The video closes with a special clip of The Miraculous Love Kids performing the song from Pakistan. Please visit them at miraculouslovekids.org God is good and may he show favor on them all Credits: Songwriters: Robert James Ritchie Produced by: Kid Rock Engineered by: Dan Frizsell Mixed by: Malay and Kid Rock Asst. Engineer: Gavin Mellberg Lead Vocal: Kid Rock Electric Guitar: Tom Bukovac Electric Guitar: JD Simo Drums: Rowan Stewart Bass: Steven Pierce Keyboards: Jim "Moose" Brown Background Singer: Herschel Boone Background Singer: Shannon Curfman Background Singer: Amanda Gene Rowland Label: Top Dog Records Video Directed/Produced by Blake Judd DP/Produced by Dustin Hyler Edited by Matt Zervos Video Shoot Location: Kid Rock's Honky Tonk - Nashville, TN.
